# zedcloud_app_instance_snapshot (Resource)

Takes an immediate snapshot of an edge application instance. The controller keeps one snapshot per app instance, so a new snapshot replaces the previous one. Not supported for app instances deployed to an edge node cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Take an immediate snapshot of an edge app instance, for example before a
# risky change. Change a trigger value to take a new one.
#
# The controller keeps one snapshot per app instance: a new snapshot (from any
# resource, the UI, zcli, or an update with snapshot_on_update) replaces the
# previous one, and Terraform then drops the replaced resource from state.
# Use one zedcloud_app_instance_snapshot per app instance, and don't combine
# it with snapshot_on_update on the same zedcloud_application_instance: each
# would delete the other's snapshot.
#
# Before taking the snapshot, the provider checks that the edge node's API
# capability level is at least API_CAPABILITY_VOLUME_SNAPSHOTS_IMMEDIATE. The
# edge node restarts the app to take the snapshot. Not supported for app
# instances deployed to an edge node cluster.
resource "zedcloud_app_instance_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  app_instance_id = zedcloud_application_instance.app.id

  triggers = {
    app_version = "1.4.0"
  }

  timeouts {
    create = "20m"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_instance_id` (String) ID of the edge application instance to snapshot.

### Optional

- `skip_capability_check` (Boolean) Skip the check that the edge node's API capability level is at least `API_CAPABILITY_VOLUME_SNAPSHOTS_IMMEDIATE` (zcli's `-f`). Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary values. Changing any of them takes a new snapshot (and, because the controller keeps one snapshot per app instance, drops the previous one).
- `wait_for_ready` (Boolean) Wait until the edge node reports the snapshot as `CREATED`. Defaults to `true`. The snapshot is taken by the edge node, so an offline node makes the wait time out.

### Read-Only

- `config_json` (String, Sensitive) The app instance configuration captured by the snapshot, as JSON, without encrypted secrets.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name, generated by the controller (`snapshot-<timestamp>-<suffix>`).
- `state` (String) Snapshot state as last reported: `CREATING`, `CREATED`, `CREATE_FAILED`, `ROLLING_BACK`, `ACTIVE`, `ROLLBACK_FAILED`, `DELETING`, `DELETE_FAILED`, `DELETED`, `IDLE` or `INVALID`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by snapshot id. List an app instance's snapshots with the
# zedcloud_app_instance_snapshots data source. triggers can't be recovered:
# if the configuration sets them, the next apply takes a new snapshot unless
# you add lifecycle { ignore_changes = [triggers] }.
terraform import zedcloud_app_instance_snapshot.before_upgrade 3f0d3b9e-6a3c-4b8e-9d7e-2c1f8e4a5b6c
```
